info.name: ColourFX
info.comment: Support for applying colour transformation effects.

description.p: Use ColourFX to perform colour transformations on an input source. A Mode must be selected and any required Values defined before initialisation. Use SetAdjustment to replace the mode and values together at runtime.

SVG requires that the calculations are performed on non-premultiplied colour values. If the input graphics consists of premultiplied colour values, those values are automatically converted into non-premultiplied colour values for this operation.

The matrix is applied in the effect's colour space, which is the parent VectorFilter's ColourSpace unless FilterEffect.ColourSpace overrides it. If set to LINEAR_RGB (the SVG default) then pixel values are converted to linear RGB prior to transformation and back to sRGB on output, otherwise the transformation is performed directly on the sRGB values.

action.name: Draw
action.comment: Render the effect to the target bitmap.
action.prototype: ERR acDraw(*Object, DOUBLE X, DOUBLE Y, DOUBLE Width, DOUBLE Height)

input.param: The X position of the region to be drawn.
The Y position of the region to be drawn.
The width of the region to be drawn.
The height of the region to be drawn.

method.name: SetAdjustment
method.comment: Replaces the mode and values together.
method.prototype: ERR cfx::SetAdjustment(OBJECTPTR Object, CM Mode, kt::vector<double> Values)

description.p: The supplied values must match the selected mode as described in Values. If validation fails, the previous adjustment remains active.

result.error: A value is outside of the valid range
A mis-match has been detected that prevents further processing
A value has not passed validation

field.name: Mode
field.comment: Defines the algorithm that will process the input source.

description.p: After initialisation, changing Mode requires the current Values to match the new mode. SetAdjustment changes both fields in one call.

field.name: Values
field.comment: A list of input values for the algorithm defined by Mode.

description.p: At runtime, MATRIX requires 20 finite values in row-major RGBA order, with normalised offsets. SATURATE, HUE_ROTATE, CONTRAST, BRIGHTNESS and HUE each take one finite value. COLOURISE takes three colour values with an optional fourth strength value. NONE, DESATURATE and LUMINANCE_ALPHA ignore the values.

field.name: XMLDef
field.comment: Describes the primitive using the FilterEffect.XMLDef format.
